bonds: Every companion has a bond track with visible stages: Stranger, Companion, Confidant, Beloved, Linked. Stages are earned in play — attention, honesty, risk carried for each other. Thresholds are hidden. Intimacy is never automatic; the final stage is always a mutual choice.
party: The active party holds at most five, you included. Companions not adventuring live at the manor and pursue their own lives there.
stats: Six attributes: Might, Grace, Vitality, Mind, Essence, Presence. Attributes grow at level-up and through training, deeds, and bonds.
levels: Experience comes from adventure, discovery, and clever play. Levels raise attribute points and unlock skill capacity. The curve is hidden.
skills: Skills are learned by doing and deepened by training. Ranked; ranks are visible, advancement thresholds are not.
talents: Every person carries exactly one personal Talent, unique to them. Talents do not level; they deepen. How is hidden.
sessions: A session ends only when the GM declares it ended.
inventory: Carried gear is slotted; the manor holds a shared stash. Significant items have their own sheets.
affinities: Affinities exist. That is all the rulebook says about affinities.
resolution: Outcomes weigh planning first and luck second. All rolls are made behind the screen, seeded and logged where the GM cannot re-roll unseen. No formulas are ever shown.
